properties.name: camel.component.jira.access-token
properties.description: The access token. If none of the consumerKey, privateKey and verificationCode options is set, the component sends it as a personal access token in a Bearer Authorization header. Otherwise it is the OAuth 1.0a access token. Not used when the username option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.bridge-error-handler
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.configuration
properties.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints, as an org.apache.camel.component.jira.JiraConfiguration. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint override the copy. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.jira.JiraConfiguration type.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.consumer-key
properties.description: The consumer key of the OAuth 1.0a application link in Jira, for OAuth authentication with the privateKey, verificationCode and accessToken options. Not used when the username option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.delay
properties.description: The time between two polls of the consumer, in milliseconds unless the timeUnit option sets another unit. The producer does not use it.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the jira component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.health-check-consumer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

properties.name: camel.component.jira.health-check-producer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.jira-url
properties.description: The URL of the Jira server, for example https://jira.example.com, to which the component sends its REST API requests.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.password
properties.description: The password for basic authentication, or an API token on Jira Cloud. Only used when the username option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.private-key
properties.description: The RSA private key of the OAuth 1.0a consumer, as Base64-encoded PKCS#8 without the PEM header and footer. The component signs each request with it (RSA-SHA1), for OAuth authentication. Not used when the username option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.username
properties.description: The username for basic authentication, which is the email address of the account on Jira Cloud. If set, the component uses basic authentication with the password option, and does not use the accessToken and OAuth options.

properties.name: camel.component.jira.verification-code
properties.description: The OAuth 1.0a verification code (oauth_verifier) that Jira showed when the user authorized the request token, for OAuth authentication with the consumerKey, privateKey and accessToken options. Not used when the username option is set.
